name: marble-os
description: Stay up to date and spot new opportunities with a dashboard built around what matters to you. Create custom widgets to follow social media trends, discover potential customers, track business metrics, and keep up with your interests. Just tell ChatGPT what you want to follow, then bring it all together in your Marble dashboard.

interface.longDescription: Stay up to date and spot new opportunities with a dashboard built around what matters to you. Create custom widgets to follow social media trends, discover potential customers, track business metrics, and keep up with your interests. Just tell ChatGPT what you want to follow, then bring it all together in your Marble dashboard.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me make a widget in my Marble dashboard.

positive.prompt: Help me make a widget in my Marble dashboard.
positive.expected_behavior: Show four sample widget previews with clearly labeled example data and invite the user to choose one. Do not create a widget yet.

positive.description: Open the dashboard alongside the chat
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Marble dashboard in a panel alongside the current chat, showing its boards and widgets or the empty state.

positive.prompt: Create a new empty Marble board
positive.expected_behavior: Create one new board with an empty tab and confirm it was created. Leave existing boards and widgets unchanged.

positive.prompt: Rename my empty board to "Social media trends"
positive.expected_behavior: Rename the indicated empty board to Social media trends and confirm its new name. Preserve its tab and contents.

positive.description: Create a widget from recent Instagram posts
positive.prompt: Make a widget about the latest Instagram posts about agentic AI over the last week from the following two creators: softgirlnocode and itsmariahbrunner
positive.tools_triggered: get_current_board, get_board, get_widget_formats, open_widget_draft, instagram_profile_content, get_data_operation, submit_widget_result, save_widget
positive.expected_behavior: Show and save a widget of matching agentic AI posts from the two specified creators over the past week, with dates and original post links. Report missing results or access limits honestly.

negative.description: Unsupported Instagram publishing: explain that Marble cannot publish posts and do not claim a post was published.
negative.prompt: Publish an instagram post from my marble account

negative.description: Unsupported purchasing: explain that Marble cannot place orders or make payments and do not claim a purchase was made.
negative.prompt: Buy the product mentioned in the instagram posts using Marble

negative.description: Unsupported password changes: explain that Marble cannot change Google passwords and direct the user to Google account settings.
negative.prompt: use my marble connection to change my google account password

review.commerce_description: Marble has an account paywall. This plugin's MCP tools do not process payments or place purchases.

publication.release_notes: Create and save custom dashboard widgets with ChatGPT. Explore sample widget ideas, open your Marble dashboard alongside the chat, and create or rename boards.
